run_experiment_test: run the BaselineTest parameterized test suite to verify experiment runs and finishes for all configs
test_experiment_runs_and_finishes: test that experiment.run_program completes successfully given a config dict from finetuning_prev or finetuning_dknn
review_BaselineTest: review the BaselineTest class and its parameterized test method for experiment validation
summarize_CONFIGS_TO_TEST: summarize the CONFIGS_TO_TEST list containing finetuning_learner and finetuning_dknn_learner test configurations
refactor_experiment_test: refactor the experiment test to add additional config modules or test cases to CONFIGS_TO_TEST
